title: Parsing the 'Exceptional Researcher' Exception: When Do Academic Claims Unlock Restricted Capabilities?

original_idea.body:
# Parsing the 'Exceptional Researcher' Exception: When Do Academic Claims Unlock Restricted Capabilities?

**Problem:** OpenAI Trusted Access includes an invite-only tier for researchers. The criteria for what makes a researcher 'exceptional' enough for elevated access are unpublished, creating an opaque governance decision point.

**Direction:** Infer the implicit criteria from OpenAI Trusted Access announcement language and analogous programs (CERN beam time allocation, NIH select agent access). Design a rubric for researcher access decisions. Test the rubric on 20 hypothetical applicant profiles varying on h-index, affiliation, publication venue, and research purpose. Assess rubric consistency.

**Why it matters:** Access governance decisions made by opaque criteria are ungovernable by external auditors. Explicit criteria are necessary for equity, consistency, and accountability.

**Relevant context:** OpenAI Trusted Access researcher tier; CLAUDE.md source credibility guidelines; Global South researcher access equity.
